file_stem: RWB E1 067 Every Workbench action into the interaction ledger
title: Every Workbench action into the interaction ledger
goal: Every automated Workbench action on a case shows in the ledger, with duplicate events rejected and counted
why: The case history must include what the system did, not only what people did: creation, allocation, transfer, escalation, documents and decisions.
ace_note: No ACE read. Inputs are Workbench events from the outbox.
stores: Outbox (at-least-once, ordered per case); exception queue for RW-PLATADM
rules: BR1: all 6 actions write a ledger entry
BR3: the same key gives one entry; repeats are counted
BR7: no personal data in event payloads
risks: Duplicate event -> one entry + a hit
Write fails -> 3 retries, then exception queue (MSG-P1-022)
example: RW-2026-000301: created 06:10, allocated to MTG-BKK-CO 06:40, transferred by u-teammgr-03
then DOC-SYN-3011 stored, SLA-ASSIGNED breached, DLE-SYN-3012 decided
